name: Cosutte! My Honey
source:
Main character quits previous job because of sexual harassment. A passing woman invites him to work together. However, it's a work in a female collective where some women resent to work with men. Protagonist agrees to dress as a woman for this job. Will he be able to get along with the girls?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公鹰科千秋因性骚扰风波丢掉了上一份工作。一名偶然路过的女子邀请他与自己共事，可那是一家只有女性员工的公司，其中一些人非常厌恶与男性一起工作。为了得到这份工作，主人公答应男扮女装。他能否顺利与女孩们相处？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
